item_wooden_sword.name: wooden sword
item_wooden_sword.description: A plain sword of dark wood bound with cord. It cuts better than it has any right to.

item_small_shield.name: small shield
item_small_shield.description: A small round shield of dark wood. It turns thrown stones and little else.

item_bow.name: bow
item_bow.description: A short bow of yew. Each arrow you loose costs you a rupee, and is worth it.

item_boomerang.name: whirlwing
item_boomerang.description: A curved throwing-stick of pale wood. Thrown, it spins out, stuns what it strikes and comes back to your hand.

item_small_key.name: small key
item_small_key.description: A small iron key. It opens one door, and then it has done its work.

item_bomb.name: bomb
item_bomb.description: A fused ball of black powder. Lit where you stand, it hurts what is near, and some walls give way to it.

item_recovery_heart.name: recovery heart
item_recovery_heart.description: A small red heart that glows faintly. Held to the chest, it mends a heart's worth of wounds.

item_shard_1.name: first shard of the Starcrown
item_shard_1.description: A bright sliver of the Starcrown that once held Ardenmoor whole. It is warm to the touch.
